record.field: This queue is created by default when 'Inouk Message Queue' module installs.

**TESTING QUEUE - DO NOT USE FOR PRODUCTION OR USER MESSAGES**
This queue is reserved exclusively for IMQ testing and development purposes. All messages in this queue may be deleted without notice during test execution.
⚠️ WARNING: This queue is automatically reset by test suites ⚠️ WARNING: Do not send production or user messages to this queue ⚠️ WARNING: Messages may be lost during testing
Used by: - test_queue_depth_metrics.sh (queue depth metrics testing) - run_tests.sh (general IMQ testing) - CI/CD pipelines and automated test suites - Development and debugging tools (imqtest, imqdump) - Performance benchmarking and load testing
Technical specifications: - PostgreSQL provider for reliable deterministic testing - Standard queue type for predictable message ordering - 5-minute visibility timeout optimized for test cycles - Automatically managed by test frameworks
